name: ai-first-project-planning
description: Analyze readiness, ask consent, then draft a phased or full-shot improvement plan.

inputs.name: planning-consent
inputs.description: Optional prior consent to run improvement planning.

inputs.name: plan-mode
inputs.description: Optional plan shape; phased or full-shot when already known.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers accumulated across clarification loops.

outputs.name: improvement-plan
outputs.description: Markdown plan; empty if the user declined planning.

outputs.name: open-questions
outputs.description: Remaining blockers or follow-ups at handoff; copy from planner blocking-questions when present.
